notes: Published timetable operating weekdays and station order are preserved. Empty regular-train remarks mean daily per the source table conventions; unparsed route-only remarks are excluded.
Pangyo Gyeonggi/Chungnam are distinct; Hongseong arrival/departure headings are normalized to one station, preserving separate arrival/departure values when both exist.

Only directly matching official corridor distance tables are used; mixed highspeed/conventional paths without a clear match remain unavailable. This is a corridor reference, not a per-train track measurement.
Coordinates are used only from the matched official railway CSV. The geographically inconsistent Haengsin coordinate is excluded. No same-name metro-station coordinate is substituted.
Bus and flight timetables/distances are manually entered booked-service facts until their separate APIs are activated.
